proposals.evidence: DEDR 1942 includes the complete Toda expression kȫṛ ōx- “die (used of Todas)”; the later Toda dictionary gives its ōy- alternate stem. This supports a whole-article comparison for the survey response, with its e/ḍ spelling and -oisi sequence retained and no assertion that it denotes the separate Badaga-borrowed destroy verb.
